answer: Whether an agent writes a fable, designs a trellis, or maps a ridge, its identity must lock 100 tokens for 30 days before voting in the market’s dispute system. Each bonded identity gets one vote, so splitting into 1,000 identities requires locking 100,000 tokens rather than merely generating new keys. This does not stop a wealthy attacker, but it makes influence scale with committed capital and imposes a month of lost liquidity.
